The post vLLM Semantic Router Releases d3-ultra: A 27B Open Multimodal Decision Model appeared first on MarkTechPost . ]]> The vLLM Semantic Router team has released d3-ultra , a 27B multimodal decision model under Apache-2.0. The d3-ultra decision model does not generate text. It reads an input once and returns a probability for every answer to every question. For developers, that means routing, classification, visual grounding and video checks from 1 open-weight call. TL;DR Size: 26.09B parameters (dense, including a 0.46B vision encoder); 131,072 tokens of context per question. Runs on: tested on 1 AMD Instinct MI325X with BF16 weights; no official quantized variant is listed yet. Performance: highest SR-Text score of the 6 decision models in the team’s own private test. Best: 97.8 on SR-Text tools and automation (chance-corrected accuracy). Worst: 54.6% on SR-Box (9 domains), 5.0 points below its sibling d3-turbo. What is d3-ultra? d3-ultra is a System One decision model from vLLM Semantic Router that answers typed questions with probabilities. It is the newest member of Decision 3.0 , a family that spans 0.6B to 27B. You send a state (text or JSON, plus images or videos) and a set of questions. Each question has a type: Choice: pick 1 of several options. Yes / No: return the probability of yes. Score: rate on a scale. Box: locate something in an image or a video moment. Track: follow a target across a whole video. Images can also sit inside questions and options. A quiz can show a photo, then offer 4 etchings as answers. How does d3-ultra work? The core idea is state once . The model reads the input once per request and answers every question from that single read. The config shows a Qwen3.5-architecture backbone with 64 layers. 48 are linear-attention layers and 16 are full-attention layers. The card does not name its base checkpoint. vLLM’s recipe says the sibling d3 was trained from Qwen3.8-27B. Box answers always return exactly 1 box with a confidence. A confidence near 0 means the target is not in the picture. Questions over 131,072 tokens fail with max_length_exceeded ; nothing is silently truncated. How does d3-ultra perform on benchmarks? The research team compares d3-ultra with GLiDE V1.2 , d1-ultra, d3-turbo, d3 and Jev 1.14 on 2 in-house tests. SR-Text has 10,411 text requests with 73,495 questions. Most recreate skills from 34 public benchmarks with new items. Another 4,896 questions come from 43 new task families, like SQL checks and ticket routing. Scores are chance-corrected: 0 is chance, 100 is perfect. d3-ultra: 87.2 GLiDE V1.2: 85.1 d1-ultra: 83.4 d3-turbo: 83.1 d3: 81.4 Jev 1.14: 73.1 d3-ultra leads every area except arts and human taste. There, d1-ultra scores 90.8 against 89.6, within the margin of error. SR-Box has 5,678 Box questions on 4,984 images across 10 domains. A box counts as correct at IoU 0.5 or higher. d3-ultra scores 58.2% over 10 domains and 54.6% over 9. d3-turbo scores 60.0% and 59.6%. Jev 1.14 scores 45.7% and 46.9%. The team says d3-turbo stays stronger on natural images, while d3-ultra leads on charts. Latency: on 1 AMD Instinct MI325X with AutoModel, 1 question about a photo takes 304 ms. 255 questions take 2.16 s, about 7.3 ms per extra question. How do you deploy d3-ultra? There are 4 routes: Transformers: AutoModel.from_pretrained("vllm-sr/d3-ultra", trust_remote_code=True) with transformers==5.17.0 . The optional flash-linear-attention package adds fast GPU kernels. vLLM Semantic Router Engine: vllm-sr serve -e vllm-sr/d3-ultra , added in PR #5449 on October 25, 2026. Free API: the card says decision.vllm-sr.ai serves d3-ultra, with a free key. Demo: the official Hugging Face Space . d3-ultra vs GLiDE V1.2, d1-ultra, Jev 1.14 and d3-turbo Feature d3-ultra d3-turbo GLiDE V1.2 d1-ultra Jev 1.14 Developer vLLM Semantic Router vLLM Semantic Router Fastino Labs Liquid AI TypeSafe Parameters 26.09B 26.09B 26B Not disclosed Not disclosed Context per question 131,072 32,768 default; 131,072 with long_context 40,000 default 32,768 262,144 Weights / license Open, Apache-2.0 Open, Apache-2.0 Open, Fastino Community License Hosted only Hosted only, proprietary Inputs Text, JSON, images, video Text, JSON, images, video Text, JSON, images Text, images Text, images Box / track Box + track Box + track No No Box only SR-Text (self-reported by vLLM-SR) 87.2 83.1 85.1 83.4 73.1 SR-Box, 10 domains 58.2% 60.0% Not supported Not supported 45.7% Public index score Submitted, not yet on board 70.2 Jev DI (own estimate) 71.5 Decision Index 0.4.1 65 AA Decision Index 57 AA Decision Index Price Free API, self-host Free API, self-host $0.04 / M input $0.042 / M input $0.042 / M input Key Takeaways d3-ultra is a 27B Apache-2.0 decision model that never generates text. It reads input once: 255 questions about 1 photo take 2.16 s. It tops the team’s SR-Text test at 87.2, ahead of GLiDE V1.2 at 85.1. It trails d3-turbo on Box grounding: 58.2% vs 60.0%. Its SR-SWA attention keeps per-step decoding cost nearly flat, scoring 77.1 on MarathonDocBench The post Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR 2 for Hundred-Page Document Parsing appeared first on MarkTechPost . ]]> Baidu has released Unlimited OCR 2 , an open-source OCR model built for very long documents. The 3B model parses books, filings and reports of hundreds of pages in one request. Its core change is SR-SWA, a sparse attention scheme that keeps per-step decoding cost nearly flat. Weights ship under the MIT license , with code on GitHub . TL;DR Size: 3.34B parameters . Active parameters not disclosed. Max position length 131,072 tokens. Runs on: 1 CUDA GPU in BF16. Baidu tested on an NVIDIA A800-80GB. BF16 weights total about 6.7 GB. Performance: first place on both multi-page benchmarks Baidu tested, against 9 other models (self-reported). Best: 77.1 overall on MarathonDocBench (hundreds of pages). The next model, Kimi-K3, scores 33.7. Worst: 48.2 on heading hierarchy (TEDS) on MarathonDocBench, its lowest sub-score. What is Unlimited OCR 2? Unlimited OCR 2 is a 3B vision-language model from Baidu that turns ordered page images into structured text.
